text.p: -- Josephthal Lyon & Ross Inc analyst Frank Barkoey started coverage of Poughkeepsie Savings Bank FSB Tuesday with a rating of buy.

-- "We estimate 1997 earnings will advance more than 40 percent to $0.38 a share from operating results of $0.27 a share in 1996 and that earnings momentum will continue at a strong pace in 1998, with results, we estimate, increasing to $0.50 a share," Barkoey wrote in an analysis.

-- "Based solely on fundamentals, we value the shares on a 12-month time frame at 7-1/4. On a takeover of this attractive franchise at a conservative multiple of current book value of only 1-1/2 - 1-3/4 (times), we value the shares at about $8.50 - $10."
-- Shares in the company opened up 1/16 at six.
